latest.title: A Lagrangian superposition principle for the continuity equation with reaction
latest.abstract: We study the continuity equation with reaction $\partial_t\mu + \operatorname{div}(v\mu) = w\mu$ on $[0,T]\times\mathbb{R}^d$, driven by Borel velocity and reaction fields $v$ and $w$. We provide the first version of a Lagrangian superposition principle for the equation in its natural generality, assuming only finite quadratic energy without imposing boundedness conditions on the reaction term neither any form of compactness for the support of the measure. More precisely, every solution $\mu \in \mathcal{C}([0,T];\mathscr{M}_+(\mathbb{R}^d))$ with finite quadratic energy is represented by a probability measure $\eta$ on absolutely continuous curves in the geometric cone over $\mathbb{R}^d$, concentrated on the solutions of the characteristic system $x' = v(x)$, $k' = w(x)\,k$, through the $2$-homogeneous marginal $h^2_t(\eta)=\mu_t$. We also establish the converse implication. The proof passes through a regularization of the triple $(v,w,\mu)$ which produces fields satisfying only local bounds; the core of the argument is therefore a representation theory under such local assumptions, whose key tool, of independent interest, is a two-time representation formula relating $\mu_s$ and $\mu_t$ along the flow of $v$ for arbitrary times $s,t$.
latest.workSummary: 论文建立带反应项的连续性方程的 Lagrangian superposition principle，允许速度和反应场仅为 Borel 且只假设有限二次能量。作者把正测度提升到带出生和死亡权重的 cone 空间，在 cone 上证明绝对连续曲线、重整化与紧性，再以截断和比较估计构造路径测度，最后投影回原连续性方程。
latest.breakthrough: Theorem 1.1 去除了反应项有界和测度支集紧的限制，在自然二次能量假设下给出路径表示；Example 1.2 展示质量在特定时刻被毁灭或创造，说明 cone 变量确实编码 reaction。
latest.limitations: 表示依赖有限二次能量和相应可积性，路径只在几乎处处时间意义下恢复方程；不提供任意 Borel 场的经典流唯一性。

steps.claim: cone 曲线编码输运和反应两个速度分量。
steps.route: Lemma 2.1 将 cone 曲线的 metric derivative 分解为底空间速度和径向质量变化，径向运动对应 w $\mu $。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 7--8 页第 2 节 Lemma 2.1。

steps.claim: 重整化和紧性为路径构造提供闭性。
steps.route: Lemma 2.2 对路径测度做权重重整化，Lemma 2.3 证明带增长函数泛函下半连续，使局部截断测度列能取弱极限。

steps.claim: 比较估计控制截断路径测度。
steps.route: Proposition 3.1 对两个连续性方程解作反应加权距离比较，Lemma 3.2 将测试函数和截断误差送入有限二次能量界。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 11--16 页 Proposition 3.1、Lemma 3.2 及证明。

steps.claim: 极限路径测度投影后满足 Eulerian 方程。
steps.route: 第 4 节 two-time representation 先表达路径边缘，再通过测试函数积分和截断极限识别 $div(v\mu )$ 与 $w\mu ，Section$ 5 完成主定理。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 15--21 页第 4.2--5 节 two-time representation 和 Proof of Theorem 1.1。
